name: agent-register
description: Active agent auto-registration — hosts self-announce + heartbeat; metadata drives role/tag assignment.

cli.summary: Manage host self-registrations + install-script for new agents

verbs.name: list
verbs.summary: List every registered agent and its last-seen state
verbs.table: (.agents // .) | (if type=="array" then . else [] end) | sort_by(.hostname) | .[] | [.hostname // "-", .ip // "-", .role // "-", .status // "-", (.last_seen | strftime("%H:%M:%S")), ((.metadata.tags // []) | join(","))]

verbs.name: install-script
verbs.summary: Print the one-liner shell installer a new host runs

verbs.name: forget
verbs.summary: Remove an agent registration (host stops being tracked)
